title: RTEC Title VI / Limited English Proficiency program
coordinator_evidence: January 2026 plan identifies Clarissa Hodge as Title VI Coordinator/EEO Manager.
program_components: Title VI facility-equity analysis when applicable
operational_rules_from_2026_source: Title VI information is to be displayed in RTEC public areas, facilities, buses and website.
New-employee orientation includes Title VI expectations.
Customer Service and Operations staff receive LEP-awareness training and retraining.
Language-assistance encounters are tracked for program evaluation.
Federally funded vendors/subcontractors are subject to Title VI requirements and contract nondiscrimination language.
The Title VI Coordinator maintains complaint/lawsuit/correspondence/investigation records.
Facility siting that triggers the plan's equity-analysis requirement must be analyzed before preferred-site selection.
Public-participation methods should be accessible and include outreach to low-income, minority and LEP populations.
unresolved_questions: Has any Title VI/LEP revision after the January 19, 2026 board approval been adopted?
Which current systems/logs record language-assistance encounters, Title VI training and public-participation evidence?
privacy_controls: Complaint/case content remains restricted; generalized program records store only process and non-identifying aggregate evidence.
